jobs.description:
The opportunity
HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems.
HVDC Service, based in Ludvika, Sweden, is now looking for a Manager to take on the role as the leader for the Service Warranty & Care to support and develop the individuals and the group and work for development of the department for a global growth.
In this role, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of 15-20 professionals reporting directly to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that engineering teams are adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations.
Your Responsibilities
HVDC Services core is to lead and manage employee relations, development and engage relations to foster a sense of community among employees.
Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing employee training and development initiatives
Providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function and operational work together with technical specialists.
Providing insight and managing priorities for the team while ensuring activities’ performance and quality goals are met during all project phases.
Taking a proactive approach and actively participate in recruiting activities.
Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure.
Partnering with the management team to develop, improve, and implement strategic people management initiatives and ensuring processes are in place to capture and share best practices and operational experiences.

Your Background
Experience as a people manager, or other relevant leadership or management experience with personnel responsibility, is highly qualifying.
Experience in technology, engineering, electrical design, hardware design, or similar is required (if you have worked with HVDC technology before it is a plus).
Strong communication, social, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees and management. 
Clear in decision making and have the right inner drive to take on full responsibility for your scope and deliver on time in a dynamic environment.
Fluency in Swedish and English is a must. 

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​

Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Additional information
The role is based in Ludvika and requires frequent presence at our office, with flexibility of hybrid working.
If you are passionate about people and how groups work together, we encourage you to apply! Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​

jobs.occupation: Module Design (CAD) Engineer for Hydraulics in Heat Pump application
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort

We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.
Job Description
Your contribution to something big:
Heat pump technology is acknowledged as a key solution for residential heating and cooling, enabling significant reductions in CO2 emissions.
You will join a growing, cross-functional product development team, working on the hydraulics of residential heat pump solutions. As a Design Engineer, you will contribute to the delivery of innovative Bosch products with class-leading performance, helping to reduce our carbon footprint.
Analyze customer, product, and safety requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions;
Responsible for developing, maintaining and releasing product engineering deliverables and specifications such as:
3D CAD Models:
Hydraulic components and assemblies;
Design metallic parts, thermoplastic parts, piping;
Hydraulic connections/interfaces concepts;
Tolerance Analysis (2D, 3D, Statistical):
2D CAD Component, Sub-Assembly and Module Assembly Drawings:
Generate technical documentation, drawings (2D) for all product components;
Create MOS (Material Order Specification) for applicable parts;
Specify materials for product components and investigate alternatives for current parts;
Apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) taking into account manufacturing processes and part function/performance demands;
Create and maintain BOM (Bill of Materials) for all assemblies.
Make feasibility analysis of cost / quality effective updates for current products.
Define rapid prototyping solutions, in accordance with application and product technical and quality requirements to be possible to validate the solutions.
Contribute in the definition of standards for Mechanical CAD Design topics.
Coordinate product market-introduction activities, including:
Product testing
Product certification
Technical documentation
Support for production ramp-up activities
Promote quality awareness and contribute to the continuous optimization of the existing product portfolio
Apply product-engineering and quality tools, including FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), 8D, and DRBFM (Design Review Based on Failure Mode)

Qualifications
What distinguishes you:
Education:
M.SC – Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

Technical Skills:
Experience in the design of hydraulic components and circuits, including plastic and metallic parts, preferably using CAD 3D Siemens Unigraphics (NX).
Experience in specification of new components, material selection, manufacturability, tolerance chain calculation.
Knowledge of materials engineering.
Understanding of manufacturing processes, construction and assembly methods. 
Knowledge in the design of hydraulic and structural components and systems is valued.
Knowledge in the product lifecycle management (PLM) software - Teamcenter: Siemens PLM Software.
Familiarity with Product Development tools (FMEA, DFMA, FAM) is valued.
Proficient with Microsoft office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, OneNote).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English 

Personal Skills:
Ownership, initiative, and a structured approach to developing solutions
Results-oriented, proactive, and committed to delivering
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments
Clear, precise, and structured communicator, able to explain complex topics effectively
Willingness to travel and work in an international environment

Additional Information
Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch         
 
Compensation and Benefits
Competitive salary, Pension plans, health insurance, and other benefits according to the collective bargin.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
Employee discounts on Bosch products.

We are looking for a researcher in Psychology for a fixed-term position at the School of Behavioral, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR). The research is within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Psychology.
Background
The Division of Psychology at Örebro University is part of the School of Behavioural, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR), together with the Divisions of Legal Science, Criminology, and Social Work.
Örebro university is now hiring a researcher within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging, with a particular focus on early life predictors of brain structural and functional connectivity in older age. The research will be conducted within the research environment LEADER (Center for Lifespan Developmental Research), which is headed by Jonas Persson, Professor in Psychology.
Duties and responsibilities
The research duties include preprocessing and analyses of structural and functional brain imaging data obtained by magnetic resonance imaging. A particular focus will be on analysing diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) data to assess structural connectivity and brain network properties in older age and how these related to health, cognition, lifestyle and other factors in childhood and adolescence. Analyses of functional connectivity data from resting-state fMRI images and the relationship with early life predictors is also expected. The applicant will also have a leading role in dissemination of the results through international peer-reviewed publication and presentations.  
Qualifications
Those qualified for the appointment as a researcher are applicants who have obtained a doctoral degree or have a degree from abroad deemed to correspond to a doctoral degree.
Assessment criteria
A general basis for assessment is that the applicant is able to demonstrate the personal qualities required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities at hand; that they are able to cooperate with other members of staff; and contribute to the development of university operations.
Specific personal abilities that are of great importance for the position is documented expertise in the fields of cognitive aging and brain imaging. Of particular importance is proficiency in analysing structural brain connectivity data, connectome-based modelling and tractography of diffusion-tensor imaging (DTI)/DWI data combined with a documented ability in analysing functional MRI data. Experience of working with longitudinal MRI data is also highly desirable, along with experience in working with software such as Matlab, R and SPM.
Information
This is a fixed-term full-time position for 12 months. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.
For more information about the position, contact Jonas Persson +46 19 301428, email: jonas.persson@oru.se, or Head of Unit Terese Glatz, +46 19 301205, email: terese.glatz@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Application
The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.
For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:
Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
Account of research qualifications and experience
Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.
 More information for applicants will be found on our career site:  https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/
The application deadline is November 27, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application!
As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.
As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
Your role and responsibilities
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration, combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities, are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.
Are you an experienced project management leader with a passion for delivering complex projects and driving business performance? Then this could be the perfect next step in your career.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing ABB Marine & Ports' project management department, overseeing the successful execution of our global portfolio of crane terminal projects. Our projects are technically advanced, commercially complex, and strategically important, with values typically ranging from 40 MSEK to 1,000 MSEK. As most projects are executed internationally, you will operate in a dynamic and multicultural environment, collaborating with customers, partners, and colleagues around the world.
Your primary focus will be to ensure outstanding project execution through strong leadership, effective governance, commercial oversight, and strategic direction. You will lead a team of highly experienced project managers and play a key role in delivering business success, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across the project portfolio.
You will report to the Operations Manager, ABB Marine & Ports and be based at our office in Västerås, Sweden.
Your main responsibilities
Lead the Project Management Department and ensure the successful execution of ABB Marine & Ports' project portfolio, on time, within scope, and within budget.

Contribute to the continued development of project management processes, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the ABB Marine & Ports business.

Qualifications for the role
Technical Bachelor's or Master's degree within a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience.
Extensive experience as a Senior Project Manager, with a successful track record of delivering large and complex industrial, infrastructure, automation or engineering projects.
Strong project management expertise, including project governance, risk management, planning, execution, and delivery in an international environment.

We are looking for a new Lead Technician based at our site in Cloud, Overturingen!
A Snapshot of Your Day
As our Lead Technician, you will be responsible for the daily leadership and supervision of service technicians, ensuring efficient planning and execution of service, operations, and warranty activities for turbines within your service area. You will build a long-term perspective with the team to ensure that Siemens Gamesa consistently delivers high performance and value to our customers.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Perform tasks delegated by the responsible Operations Manager.
Coordinate, plan, and execute service, operational, and support activities for the assigned site or travelling technician team, including resource planning, vacation scheduling, and work rosters in collaboration with central planning.
Ensure that safety is always the top priority, and that all technicians have the required training, safety equipment, work instructions, and risk assessments before commencing any work.
Continuously follow up on incidents and drive improvements by implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.
Ensure that site personnel and subcontractors are informed of and comply with agreed EHS procedures and the site-specific EHS plan.
Utilize local and regional technical support resources to resolve technical issues on site.
Take corrective actions, address deficiencies, and drive continuous improvements within the service teams.
Be responsible for the ongoing development and improvement of productivity, KPIs, and other site and contract objectives, supported by the Operations Manager.
Provide monthly reporting to customers and lead monthly customer meetings with support from the Operations Manager.
Build long-term relationships with customers as the primary site contact and collaborate closely with suppliers to establish lasting partnerships.
Manage operations under varying conditions and adjust work and resource planning to meet contractual obligations, optimize wind farm performance, and maximize team productivity.
Lead the team in maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation and records.
Handle site administration, including reporting, order management, record keeping, and related administrative responsibilities. 

What You Bring
A passion for renewable energy and a commitment to driving the energy transition.
The ideal candidate has a technical or vocational education, preferably with an electrical and/or mechanical background and relevant experience. You have several years of experience in a leadership, supervisory, or team lead role.
In addition, you will:
Demonstrate excellent planning and organizational skills.
Have a technical background in electrical, mechanical, or hydraulic systems.
Possess experience as a supervisor, team leader, or similar.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment and preferably have experience within the wind energy sector.
Be able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken. Swedish is considered a significant advantage.
Hold a valid Category B driving licence.
Be physically fit and comfortable working at heights. A medical examination is required, including the Swedish “Mast and Pole Certificate” (Mast- och Stolpintyg).

Please note that if offered the position, you will be required to successfully complete a medical examination and a drug and alcohol test before commencing employment.

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning more than 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
As a leading player in the wind power industry and a manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and delivering innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demands of communities worldwide. jobs.occupation: System Tester  Pro Robotic R&D  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
System Tester – Pro Robotic R&D – Husqvarna Group
Want to help shape the future of professional robotic lawn care? Join our Pro Robotic R&D team and work hands-on with robotic mowers used in demanding professional environments.
Our team develops and maintains robotic mower solutions for customers such as football clubs, parks, commercial properties and golf courses. Reliability, efficiency and consistent performance are essential, and that is where our System Test team comes in.

As a System Tester, you will be part of the System and Test team, verifying system behaviour, functionality and overall product quality.

Role Description
This is a hands-on role where you will test our robotic products in real field environments, simulated and lab environments, as well as through automated test pipelines. You will work closely with system engineers, software and product development teams, and other test functions to understand how the complete system performs. Your responsibilities will include:
Verifying new functionality and bug fixes in field and lab environments
Performing regression and acceptance testing
Identifying, analysing and documenting deviations from requirements
Tracking test progress and ensuring coverage against requirements
Contributing to improved test methods, workflows and ways of working

The exact focus of the role can be adapted based on your previous experience, technical strengths and areas where you want to continue developing.
You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.

Your profile
You are curious, structured and quality-minded, with a genuine interest in understanding how technology works in practice. You enjoy combining hands-on testing with analysis and problem-solving. Furthermore, take ownership of your work, know how to prioritise and enjoy collaborating across different engineering disciplines in a dynamic R&D environment.
We believe you have:
At least 2 years of experience testing embedded products
A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Software Development, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or a related field
Professional proficiency in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus
A Swedish B driving licence
The possibility to travel

It’s a plus if you also have experience in:
System-level test automation
Data analytics
Linux and/or ROS
Electrical load testing
Jira or Azure DevOps
ISTQB or a similar software testing certification

Location
The role is based on-site in Huskvarna, combined with travel related to testing at field locations. You will travel approximately four times per year, with each trip lasting around two weeks.
We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

Your application
Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:
Hiring Manager: Tim Hartelius Tim.Hartelius@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina, Gorjana.Dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice: https://privacyportal.husqvarnagroup.com/en/privacy-notice

Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.
Our culture is built on three core themes:

jobs.occupation: Head of Product Line – Fire Detection, Building & Rolling Stock
jobs.description:

With more than 100 years of expertise, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of Safety Tech. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, and operating in over 55 locations worldwide, Consilium is a fast-growing global organization backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners. With strong financial support and a clear strategic vision, we are on an ambitious journey of growth and transformation — investing in innovation, operational excellence, and talent.
This is an exciting time to join us.

The Role
As Head of Product Line – Fire Detection, Building & Rolling Stock, you will hold strategic responsibility for a key part of Consilium's portfolio, driving innovation, business alignment, and long-term growth.
You will lead the development and execution of a forward-looking product strategy that supports our business objectives and strengthens our position in the global safety market. Managing a global team of Product Managers and Product Specialists, you will foster collaboration across regions and functions while building a strong "One Consilium" culture.
You will own the full product lifecycle, from roadmap and portfolio management through to market positioning and business performance. Working closely with R&D, Operations, Sales, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure our solutions meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and the highest performance and safety standards.
You will also play a central role in identifying new business opportunities, driving profitable growth, and ensuring strategic initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the product line strategy for Fire detection, Building and Rolling Stock solutions

Lead, develop, and grow a global team of Product Managers and Product specialists

Own portfolio management, product lifecycle planning, and roadmap prioritization

Partner with R&D and Technical leadership to maximize business value and ROI from development investment

Identify market trends, customer needs, and new growth opportunities

Support the commercial organization in hitting sales and profitability targets

Optimize pricing strategies, margins, and product positioning

Ensure accurate forecasting, reporting, and data-driven decision-making

Represent Consilium in customer meetings, industry forums, and strategic partnerships

Champion cross-functional collaboration and a strong global team culture

Your Profile
We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader with a passion for technology, innovation, and safety. 
You likely have:

A university degree in Engineering, Technology, Business, or equivalent experience

Proven experience in a technology industry with regulated, safety-critical products. Direct exposure to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock is a strong advantage

Proven experience within the safety technology industry, ideally related to fire detection, building safety, or rolling stock

Strong leadership experience, including leading and motivating international teams

A solid understanding of product management, product lifecycle processes, and business-driven product development

Experience working in global and cross-cultural environments

Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, profitability, and growth targets

Excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills

Experience with agile development methodologies is considered a strong advantage

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and inspiring leader who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach. You are comfortable navigating complex global environments and enjoy building strong relationships across functions and markets.

What We Offer
At Consilium, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact in a global company at the forefront of safety innovation.
We offer:

A key leadership role with global influence

The opportunity to shape the future of safety technology

A collaborative and international work environment

A culture driven by innovation, responsibility, and continuous improvement

Competitive compensation and benefits

Opportunities for professional and personal growth

Ready to Make an Impact?
If this sounds like your next challenge, we would love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of a company committed to innovation, safety, and sustainable global growth.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

🚀 We’re Hiring: DevOps Engineer – CI/CD & Embedded Systems (Level 3)
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: DevOps Engineer – CI/CD & Embedded Systems
Seniority: Level 3
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Gothenburg / Jonsered, Sweden
Work Model: On-site
Employment: Full-time (100%)
Assignment Period: 16 November 2026 – 30 September 2027
Application Deadline: 9 November 2026
Type: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to take ownership of CI/CD infrastructure and automation supporting embedded software development and cloud-based services.
You will work in a technically diverse engineering environment, with a primary focus on maintaining, developing and optimizing a locally hosted CI/CD platform built around Jenkins, Docker and Gerrit.
The role also involves working with Azure DevOps pipelines and deploying web services across AWS and Azure cloud environments.
We are looking for a technically strong professional who can independently drive infrastructure improvements, optimize development workflows and ensure stable, secure and efficient software delivery processes.
Key Responsibilities
1. CI/CD Infrastructure & Platform Management
Maintain, operate and continuously improve the existing CI/CD infrastructure based on Jenkins, Docker and Gerrit.
Ensure the stability, reliability, security and scalability of build and deployment environments.
Manage and optimize container-based build environments.
Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and implement improvements to increase efficiency and performance.
Take ownership of the overall CI/CD platform and its continuous development.

2. Jenkins Pipeline Development & Automation
Develop, maintain and optimize Jenkins pipelines.
Implement Pipeline-as-Code using Declarative and Scripted Groovy.
Develop and maintain Jenkins Shared Libraries.
Build automation solutions using Groovy and Python.
Integrate automated build, testing and code review workflows.

3. Static Code Analysis & Quality Automation
Integrate and maintain static code analysis tools within build and code review processes.
Work with tools such as CodeChecker and cppcheck.
Improve automated code quality checks and development workflows.
Ensure static analysis tools are effectively integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

4. Azure DevOps & Cloud Deployment
Develop and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines using YAML.
Manage deployment workflows for web-based services.
Support application deployment across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
Improve automation, reliability and efficiency of cloud deployment processes.
Collaborate with development teams to streamline software delivery.

5. Linux Administration & Technical Support
Perform Linux system administration and infrastructure maintenance.
Troubleshoot CI/CD platform issues and resolve technical challenges.
Document infrastructure architecture, processes and operational procedures.
Support developers in using CI/CD tools and automation workflows.
Independently plan, prioritize and execute technical improvements.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps and CI/CD engineering.
Expert-level knowledge of Jenkins, including:
Declarative and Scripted Pipelines.
Groovy programming.
Pipeline-as-Code.
Jenkins Shared Libraries.
Strong experience with Docker and container-based build environments.
Experience with Gerrit or equivalent Git-based code review platforms and CI integration.
Good programming and automation skills using Python.
Practical experience developing Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
Experience deploying and managing applications across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
Experience integrating static code analysis tools such as CodeChecker, cppcheck or equivalent solutions.
Strong knowledge of Linux system administration.
Ability to independently manage technical responsibilities, prioritize activities and drive improvements.
Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with software development teams.
Fluent in English and good proficiency in Swedish, both written and spoken.

Technical Skills & Technologies
CI/CD & Automation
Jenkins
Groovy

Volvo Energy is a young company in the Volvo Group which supports customers in the electrical energy transition. Volvo Energy develops and commercializes competitive Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and provides customers with reliable solutions which optimize energy costs, operational resilience, and renewable energy integration.
  
 We are now looking for a new colleague to join our team at Volvo Energy as Project Manager BESS installations.
 What are we looking for in this specific role? 
In this role, we are looking for an experienced project manager who can lead BESS installation projects from contract signature through energization, final acceptance, and handover. You combine strong project leadership with practical understanding of construction, electrical infrastructure, commissioning, and site execution.
  
 You are a self-motivated and results-driven team player who creates structure in complex projects and works effectively with customers, contractors, suppliers, grid owners, authorities, and internal technical or project teams. You are comfortable taking ownership of scope, schedule, cost, risk, safety, quality, and stakeholder coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  
 Responsibilities include:
  Own project scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, and execution, with regular reporting to project stakeholders.
 Develop and maintain the integrated project schedule covering permits, supplier deliveries, civil and electrical works, grid owner activities, compliance testing, commissioning, and energization milestones.
 Procure and manage installation, civil, and electrical contractors together with the design and Purchasing teams, ensuring execution according to approved designs, specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
 Serve as the primary point of contact for project execution, coordinating customers, grid owners, authorities, contractors, suppliers, aggregators, and other stakeholders.
 Lead site activities during construction, commissioning, and testing, including contractor coordination, site safety, site rules, BAS-U responsibilities, FAT, transport, lifting, SAT, system integration, compliance activities, and energization.
 Manage project risks, changes, interfaces, claims, variation orders, time extensions, and contractual milestones throughout execution.
 Lead project close-out through punch list closure, final acceptance, customer and service handover, and delivery of required documentation and training.
 Maintain a site presence aligned with project needs, particularly during critical construction, commissioning, testing, and energization activities.
  
 
 Who are you? 
Expected qualifications:
  Degree in Engineering, or equivalent knowledge gained through professional experience.
 Previous project management experience within energy, electrical infrastructure, construction, or industrial projects.
 Experience in BESS, renewable energy, grid connection, or similar infrastructure projects, including installation and commissioning.
 Understanding of project contracts, preferably ABT 06 and AB 04.
 Self-motivated, structured, and results-driven, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills and the ability to engage teams and partners in a changing project environment.
 Fluent in Swedish and English.
 Willingness to be present on site when required.
  
 
 Meriting:
  Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
 Experience acting as BAS-U.

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. 
Your opportunity 
Ready to shape how we source IT at Boliden? Join us as a Sourcing Manager and bring together technology, business and strategic sourcing. Your work will help us make smart commercial decisions while developing how we source IT across Boliden.  
We are looking for two Sourcing Managers to strengthen our IT procurement team. You will work with sourcing across software, digital services and technology supporting our industrial operations. Along the way, you will build strong supplier relationships, manage commercial risks and help create long-term value for Boliden. 
We welcome candidates at different stages of their careers. Your level of responsibility will reflect your experience, giving you the opportunity to grow while learning from colleagues with different areas of expertise. 
Who you will work with 
You will be part of Group Procurement and work closely with colleagues within IT, procurement and different parts of Boliden's business. You will also build relationships with IT suppliers, consultants and service providers.
Collaboration and knowledge sharing are important parts of the role. You will work with colleagues who bring different areas of expertise, while having the opportunity to take ownership of your sourcing assignments and contribute your own ideas. 
The positions can be based in Stockholm or Boliden, with another Boliden location potentially considered by agreement. We work according to an Office First approach, with the office as the main workplace. Business travel is part of the role and varies according to business and project needs. 
What you will do 
Key responsibilities are: 
Lead strategic sourcing IT initiatives from understanding the business need through supplier selection, contracting and implementation. 
Manage and negotiate IT contracts and commercial terms across areas such as software, licensing, hardware, IT services, consulting and telecom. 
Translate technical and business needs into clear commercial requirements and sourcing decisions. 
Build trusted relationships with IT, procurement, business stakeholders and external suppliers. 
Analyze spend and supplier markets to identify sourcing opportunities and support informed decisions. 
Contribute to IT category strategies and the continued development of how Boliden procures IT products and services. 
Contribute to responsible sourcing by balancing commercial value, sustainability, compliance and risk. 

What you bring 
You enjoy creating structure when several priorities need attention and are comfortable taking responsibility for moving an assignment forward while involving others when their expertise is needed. 
You build trusted relationships by listening to different perspectives and communicating clearly. You are comfortable working between technical and commercial stakeholders and can turn complex information into practical sourcing decisions. 
You approach challenges with curiosity and a solution-oriented mindset. You are also comfortable constructively questioning existing approaches and contributing ideas for improvement. We value colleagues who share knowledge, ask questions and contribute to an open and collaborative working environment. 
Qualifications are: 
An academic degree or relevant professional experience that provides an equivalent foundation. 
Experience in strategic sourcing or procurement. 
Understanding of IT contracts, commercial agreements and licensing models. 
Ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into commercial requirements and decisions. 
Professional proficiency in English. 
Category B driving licence. 

It is an advantage if you have: 
Experience in IT procurement or sourcing is an advantage, particularly within areas such as software, IT services, consulting, hardware or telecom. You may also bring knowledge of data protection, GDPR or cybersecurity, or experience from an IT organization, supplier or international company. Swedish or Finnish is a plus. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed. We value potential, motivation, and a willingness to learn and grow together with us.

TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.

What you’ll do
Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.

Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.
About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital capabilities, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, efficiency and long-term business success.

Digitalise and improve workflows across design, product development, sourcing, sustainability and studio production.

Through close collaboration across business, technology and operations, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.

jobs.occupation: Tax Technology Consultant | Tax Technology & Operations | Stockholm
jobs.description:
Do you want to help businesses turn complex tax rules into practical technology solutions? Join EY's Nordic Tax Technology and Operations team in Stockholm and work where indirect tax, finance and technology meet. 
 
 
The opportunity
 
Digital reporting requirements are changing how companies manage VAT and e-invoicing. In this role, you will help clients understand what new requirements mean for their data, processes and systems, and support them from early analysis through implementation. 
 
You will collaborate with tax specialists, finance teams, IT architects, developers and technology providers across the Nordics and our wider international network. This role offers the opportunity to build specialist expertise in a fast-developing area while contributing to major client projects and the continued growth of our Nordic offering. 
 
 
Your key responsibilities
 
Your responsibilities will be adapted to your experience and may include: 
Lead client workshops to understand current processes, identify needs and define requirements. 
Translate indirect tax and e-invoicing regulations into clear process and system requirements. 
Design practical solutions and documentation that connect tax, finance and technology. 
Work with client teams and delivery specialists to implement and test solutions, including SAP-based e-invoicing solutions. 
Coordinate stakeholders and contribute insights on developments such as ViDA and real-time reporting. 

 
 
Skills and attributes for success
 
You enjoy making complex topics easier to understand and can connect business needs with technology. You are comfortable working with different stakeholders and take a structured, collaborative approach to delivery. 
 
 
Qualifications
 
A university degree in taxation, business, finance, information systems, computer science or a related field.
Relevant experience in indirect tax, tax technology, finance transformation, ERP implementation or a comparable advisory environment.
The ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into clear processes, documentation or technology solutions.
Strong communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively with both business and technology stakeholders.
Knowledge of SAP, particularly SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (SAP DRC)

 
 
Meritorious
 
Experience with VAT or GST, e-invoicing, digital reporting or tax compliance transformation.
Tax technology platforms such as Avalara, Vertex or Thomson Reuters.
Familiarity with Peppol, country-specific e-invoicing frameworks, ViDA or real-time reporting requirements.
Experience with requirements gathering, solution design, user acceptance testing, agile delivery or project coordination.
Experience working with multinational organisations, cross-border teams or large-scale transformation projects.

 
 
As a person you are
 
Curious and motivated to learn in a fast-changing specialist area.
Analytical and solution-oriented, with an eye for both detail and the bigger picture.
Collaborative, clear and confident when working across tax, finance and technology teams.

 
 
What we offer you
 
Continuous learning: Develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: Tools and flexibility to make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: Insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: Be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice.

jobs.occupation: Technical Lead – IoT to Alfa Laval!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software engineer looking to lead through technical expertise, mentorship, and collaboration – while continuing to develop hands-on software? For Alfa Laval's IoT Development Team, we are now looking for a Technical Lead to drive the development of scalable IoT solutions for Alfa Laval's global product portfolio!
About the role
In this role, you will be part of a collaborative IoT development team, serving as the technical anchor and guide for engineers while turning business requirements into scalable cloud solutions.
Alfa Laval contributes to a more sustainable future through technical innovation. The company's solutions help customers improve efficiency across industries such as marine, energy, water treatment, food production, and pharmaceuticals.
Alfa Laval's IoT solutions enable remote support, data visualization, and performance analytics for industrial machinery. By analyzing data in real time, the systems help global customers optimize operations and regulatory compliance, reduce unplanned downtime, and lower their environmental footprint. Alfa Laval offers a collaborative and inclusive environment where employees are encouraged to take initiative, share ideas, and turn innovations into reality.
You are Offered
Global Impact within IoT: The opportunity to build advanced IoT solutions that connect industrial machinery and are used worldwide.
International Collaboration: Extensive collaboration with international teams and global stakeholders in an open, non-hierarchical environment.
Long-Term Development: Strong opportunities for technical growth, broader architecture responsibilities, and flexible career paths within a world-leading industrial group.
Flexibility & Balance: A collaborative work environment with a hybrid setup (based in either Flemingsberg or Lund) and a healthy work-life balance.

Work tasks
As Technical Lead in one of the IoT Development Teams, you will work closely with developers, Product Owners, Delivery Leads, business stakeholders, and DevOps teams to translate business needs into robust, dependable technical solutions. The role entails end-to-end responsibility for technical design, implementation, and estimation, while remaining actively engaged in hands-on software development and coaching the team forward. Your primary responsibilities:
Lead technical design, solution definition, and estimation activities, translating business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.  
Mentor engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, testing practices, and the promotion of engineering best practices.  
Collaborate across teams and stakeholders to align solutions, manage dependencies, and ensure efficient delivery.  
Support the full software development lifecycle, including implementation, deployment, maintenance, and operational handover.  
Remain actively involved in hands-on software development and technical problem solving, contributing where your expertise provides the greatest value.  
Ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, usability, maintainability, stability, and cybersecurity.

We are looking for someone who 

Has extensive software development experience with a strong focus on C# and .NET / .NET Core.

Has experience designing scalable backend systems and APIs for distributed environments.

Has practical experience with cloud development, primarily in Microsoft Azure (experience with AWS or GCP is also valued), as well as containerization with Docker.

Is fully proficient in English, both spoken and written (corporate and team language).

It is meritorious if you have
Experience in IoT and Telemetry: Hands-on work with connected devices, industrial monitoring, edge computing, or time-series databases (e.g., TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
Broader Architectural Expertise: Familiarity with microservices, distributed system design, or event-driven architecture.
DevOps & Tooling: Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments, Azure DevOps, Linux-based environments, or scripting languages (e.g., Python).
Frontend Understanding: Basic familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular.
Experience in technical mentorship:  You enjoy guiding other developers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices within an agile team.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Supportive
Goal oriented
Orderly
Stable
Responsible
Assertive

Other information
A background check is part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. jobs.occupation: Sales Coordinator to an International Company in the MedTech Industry!
jobs.description:
Are you a Finnish-speaking professional who enjoys taking ownership, coordinating complex processes, and working with multiple stakeholders? Do you have experience in order management, sales support, or B2B administration? Are you someone who likes to take responsibility and ensure that everything runs smoothly from start to finish? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!
We are currently looking for a Sales Coordinator to join a well-established international company within the medical technology industry. In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring that customer orders are managed efficiently, accurately, and delivered according to plan.
You will primarily support the Finnish market and become part of a collaborative Nordic sales organization based in Stockholm.
About the Role:
As a Sales Coordinator, you will have end-to-end responsibility for customer orders, from the initial order placement through to delivery and final invoicing.
This is much more than an order administration position. You will be responsible for keeping the entire process together, identifying potential issues, coordinating different departments, and ensuring that every order is handled correctly and within the agreed timeframe.
You will act as a central point of contact between customers, the sales organization, service teams, project managers, international factories, and the finance department.
Your Main Responsibilities:
Receive, review, and register customer orders, primarily via email.
Ensure that order documentation, pricing, and delivery terms are accurate and complete.
Communicate with customers and sales representatives to clarify or obtain missing order information.
Coordinate complex orders involving multiple factories, deliveries, and internal functions.
Monitor order progress and ensure that products are delivered according to schedule.
Collaborate with service coordinators and project managers to prepare for product installations.
Ensure a smooth and accurate handover to the service organization.
Follow up on open orders and ensure that invoicing takes place at the correct time.
Manage partial deliveries and invoicing in multiple stages.
Communicate deviations and changes in invoicing schedules to the finance department.
Take ownership of your orders and ensure that each process is followed through to completion.

About You:
We are looking for someone with previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
You have a good understanding of how different parts of an order process are connected, from receiving an order to coordinating deliveries and ensuring that invoicing is completed correctly.
You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and handling both routine tasks and more complex situations. You understand the importance of keeping track of details while maintaining an overview of the entire process.
To Succeed in This Role, We Believe You Have:
Approximately two years of experience in a similar position.
Previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
Experience independently managing and following up on order processes, preferably from order placement through to delivery and invoicing.
An understanding of how orders, deliveries, installations, and invoicing are connected.
Experience coordinating several internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to manage complex cases and keep multiple processes moving simultaneously.
Previous experience working with ERP or other business management systems.
Good general computer skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Experience working with SAP or Salesforce is also considered a plus.
Who Are You as a Person?
You are a responsible, structured, and proactive individual who enjoys taking ownership and driving processes forward.
You are detail-oriented and understand the importance of accuracy when handling customer orders, deliveries, and invoicing. At the same time, you are able to maintain an overview and ensure that all the different parts of the process come together.
You are confident in making decisions and taking action when something needs to be resolved. Rather than waiting for someone else to follow up, you take initiative and make sure things get done.
You also have strong communication skills and enjoy working with different stakeholders, both internally and externally. You understand the importance of keeping everyone informed and ensuring smooth collaboration between departments.
Interested?
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We would love to hear from you!
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
